findings_draft.question: Q1
findings_draft.finding: Q3 US SSS more likely ~0-0.8% than the 1.1% published consensus: Wells' own DPZ card data slowed 120bp q/q in Q3; BofA card data shows pizza sales declining May-Jul with lower-income pizza spend down most; Kalshi crowd repriced >0.5% from 0.87-0.99 (Aug-Sep) to 0.40 and >1.5% from 0.66 to ~0.15. Counter: Census real restaurant sales accelerated Jun-Aug, gas eased q/q, 50%-off week Jul 27-Aug 2 was new vs 2025, Google search y/y improved from -14.4% (Q2) to -8.5% (Q3).

findings_draft.question: Q2
findings_draft.finding: FY26 'low single digits' US comp guide needs Q4 (16 wks, lapping +3.7%) at ~2.2% for a 1% year if Q3 prints ~0.4%: trim roughly a coin flip; offset by Wells' QTD-stronger card read (Domino launch Aug 31, Oct 5-11 50%-off week) and BofA's strong September consumer incl. lower income; Google search Q4-to-date -14% y/y is the weak counter-signal.

findings_draft.question: Q3
findings_draft.finding: International ex-FX comp likely +0.5-1.5% vs +1.0-1.2% modelled: Jubilant India LFL +4.1% Jul-Sep (from +2.5%), DPG UK H1 +4.9% with July positive and an easy +1.0% Q3-25 lap, DPE first 8 weeks FY27 -5.8% (unchanged run-rate), DPC Dash Q3 SSSG still negative but ATP stabilising.

findings_draft.question: Q4
findings_draft.finding: Headline EPS carries a DPC Dash mark-to-market loss of ~$2.5m pre-tax (~$0.06/sh: HK$35.58 -> HK$30.50 on ~3.9m shares) that consensus does not model; partly offset by an international royalty consensus (-0.1% y/y) that looks conservative against Q2's +6.0%.
